metadata.article_title: Financial and administrative powers of President.

article.title: Financial and administrative powers of President.
article.content:
1142[Financial and administrative powers of President.

Section 114  ·  Chapter XVIII  ·  page 94 of the Act
The President shall exercise such financial and administrative powers over the Appellate Tribunal as may be prescribed.]
2 Subs. by Act 8 of 2023, s. 151, for section 114 (w.e.f. 1-8-2023).
